name: Net User Enum (SA)
help: Enumerates user accounts; Linux and macOS support the local POSIX database only.
long_help: On Windows, enumerates local or domain users and supports all, locked, disabled, or active account filters. On Linux and macOS, only domain=0 and filter=1 are supported and enumerate the local POSIX account database; domain mode and Windows locked/disabled account-state filters are rejected.

arguments.name: domain
arguments.desc: Query domain instead of local system (0 = local, 1 = domain)

arguments.name: filter
arguments.desc: Filter by account status: 1 = all users, 2 = locked out only, 3 = disabled only, 4 = active only (not disabled or locked)
